order: Genericize the README's install instructions so they no longer assume the maintainer's own local paths. Replace the hardcoded local path in the install example with a placeholder environment variable, and add a POSIX clone-and-install snippet alongside it so a non-maintainer user has a copy-pasteable path. Rename the internal project-name labels used in a couple of places to a neutral harness name — but the uninstaller's existing loose-prefix fallback must keep matching the old markers unchanged, so an install performed under the old name must never be left un-uninstallable. Add a permissive open-source license file at the repository root and a corresponding license section in the README; the license terms must be stated explicitly, never left implied. Touch only the README, the install script's label strings, and the new license file — no other functional behavior may change.
claims: The install example now points at a placeholder environment variable instead of a hardcoded local path, with a POSIX clone-and-install snippet added beside it. Internal labels were renamed to a neutral name while the uninstaller's loose-prefix fallback was left unchanged so it still matches markers from installs under the old name. A permissive license file and a matching README section were added; the diff spans 4 files, 41 insertions, 7 deletions.
